1.name: Call Test Validation
1.definition: Review or verify results of E911 test calls that have already been performed, including whether calls reached the intended PSAP and whether call test results are acceptable.

2.name: E911 Provisioning
2.definition: Provision or load E911 service configuration for sites, cells or sectors. Select this when the main requested action is provisioning; a general mention of E911, a PSAP, or an update does not by itself establish this class.

3.name: Expedite Request
3.definition: Expedite or prioritize an existing request or work order, usually to meet a requested deadline or launch date. The main action is acceleration or priority handling.

5.name: Other
5.definition: A substantive request outside the other configured EWOC categories under the reviewed business taxonomy. Do not treat this as a default solely because the description is short or unclear.

6.name: Prelaunch Correction
6.definition: Correct an identified configuration, audit, approval or data issue in the prelaunch stage. The request should contain prelaunch context and an action to correct a specific problem.

9.name: Testing Coordination
9.definition: Arrange or coordinate future testing: schedule a test window, obtain PSAP approval or contacts, or coordinate participants and resources for E911 testing.

11.name: Soft Test Tool Test
11.definition: Perform or handle a test explicitly associated with the named Soft Test Tool workflow, including running the tool or reviewing its output. A generic reference to testing is insufficient by itself.

13.name: Sector Deletion
13.definition: Delete, remove, retire or decommission E911 sector records. Cleanup belongs here when removal of sector records is actually requested; the word cleanup alone does not specify the action.

16.name: RBSS Lat/Long Update
16.definition: Update or correct latitude/longitude associated with an RBSS or site record in that workflow. Generic coordinates mentioned as part of another task, including BMC/WEA, do not establish this class by themselves.

20.name: Small Cell DALI and ECDM load
20.definition: Load, fill, verify or update DALI and/or ECDM data specifically for a small-cell workflow.

26.name: Direct IP PSAP Conversion
26.definition: Convert a PSAP routing or connectivity arrangement to Direct IP. The requested conversion and its associated routing or provisioning work should be central to the ticket.

28.name: PSAP Consolidation
28.definition: Consolidate or merge PSAP destinations or arrangements and perform the associated record or routing changes. The consolidation itself should be the main requested change.

40.name: BMC/WEA
40.definition: Handle a request explicitly associated with BMC/WEA configuration, maintenance or updates. Confirm the BMC/WEA workflow context; a generic latitude/longitude or E911 configuration update alone is not sufficient.
